_help: Roles you post yourself (for example, paid 'Post a role' listings).
Required: id (unique, no spaces), title, company, location, url (https://...), postedAt (YYYY-MM-DD).
Optional: expiresAt (YYYY-MM-DD), department, employmentType, featured (true shows it first).
demoOnly: true means the listing is an example and is hidden in live mode. Delete it or set it to false for real listings.
A listing disappears automatically after expiresAt, or after jobs.maxAgeDays in settings.json if no expiresAt is set.
